## Pipeline
- Our workflow follows a structured parallel analysis of porcine and human transcriptomes:
- Data Acquisition: Datasets were retrieved from the NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus: GSE61271 (Pig) and GSE162653 (Human).
- Preprocessing: Human raw counts were processed using the DESeq2 vignette (Love et al., 2014). Pig data, provided as pre-normalized counts, was analyzed using the limma user guide (Ritchie et al., 2015).
- Ortholog Mapping: Pig Ensembl IDs were converted to human gene symbols using biomaRt for cross-species compatibility.
- Pathway Analysis: We employed GSVA to calculate enrichment scores for the MSigDB Hallmark Gene Set (Liberzon et al., 2015).

```{mermaid}
graph TD
    A[GSE61271 Pig Data] --> B(limma Analysis)
    C[GSE162653 Human Data] --> D(DESeq2 Analysis)
    B --> E[biomaRt Ortholog Mapping]
    D --> F[Gene Symbols]
    E --> G[Comparative Pathway Analysis - GSVA]
    F --> G
    G --> H[Results: Conserved Inflammation vs. Divergent Metabolism]
```
